notes: Frozen public vectors for the Secure Mirror container (Docs/MIRROR-FORMAT.md). The canonical vector pins the DETERMINISTIC prefix of the container — bytes 0..<37 (magic, version, KDF id, parameters, salt, payload length) — for the fixed inputs below. The tail (GCM nonce + ciphertext) is intentionally NOT pinned: the seal path always draws a fresh random nonce, which is a security property of the format, so no two valid exports of the same inputs are byte-identical. Tamper variants are expressed as byte-offset mutations applied to a fresh canonical export. Regeneration is GENERATE_VECTORS=1, one-time recovery only — these values are a published backup contract.
